title: Skills catalog
subtitle: Skill packs installed for this organization. Open a pack to see its skills and the departments, groups and agents it is assigned to.

packs.name: Pack
packs.emptyDescription: Choose a built-in pack or install from Git above, then open a pack to manage its assignments.
packs.truncatedHint: Use olivares skills ls --cursor to list the rest.

uses.title: Assigned to
uses.none: This pack is not assigned to any department, group or agent you can see.
uses.confirmDescription: New sessions of {{target}} stop receiving these skills. Recorded conversations keep their snapshot.
uses.truncatedHint: Use olivares skills assignments --pack with --cursor to list the rest.
uses.moved: Assignment moved to the latest revision
uses.approveTitle: Approve skills that act when loaded?
uses.approveDescription: The latest revision pins skills for {{target}} that their tool acts on without asking: {{skills}}. Approve only after reviewing them.

assign.title: Assign
assign.noTargets: No targets of this kind that you can read.
assign.directoryFailed: The targets could not be loaded. Close and reopen the pack to retry.
assign.approve: I reviewed these skills and approve that their tool acts on them when loaded: {{skills}}
assign.membersHint: Choose up to 64 members. Skills, agents, commands and rules can be selected separately.

install.title: Install a skill pack
install.workspaceHint: Install only in the catalog, or also assign the returned revision to a workspace.
install.name: Pack name
install.nameHint: Optional; defaults to the repository name. Choose a distinct name for another pack from the same repository.
install.held: Skill pack installed. It carries skills that act when loaded, so it was not assigned: review it and assign it from its pack sheet.

update.title: Updates
update.available: An update is available over revision {{n}}.
update.acts: {{skill}} now acts when loaded: {{items}}. Assigning it needs your approval.
update.pinsKeep: Existing assignments keep their revision until you move each one with “Use latest”.
